summary.intent: Fix the memory loop TUI injection tab so it tests against all active memories and shows whether each would be injected or not (instead of a raw score number).
summary.outcome: The injection tab now uses PreviewSelection() to show all memories with INJECT/SKIP labels and skip reasons. Two new tests were added and all 22 TUI tests pass. The session ended with the user requesting removal of skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands.

repo: PreviewSelection() returns a SelectionReport with both Matches and Skipped fields, while SelectRelevant() only returns matched memories — use PreviewSelection for full injection preview.
The injectionRejectionReason pattern already existed in memoryloop.go with typed skip reasons (not active, scope mismatch, low strength).
explanatory_insights.go is a hook handler, not a command, and should not be removed with other commands.
skilldb, skilltui, permissions, and insights each have their own subdirectory under cmd/entire/cli/.

code.finding: testPromptResultMsg was changed to carry a full SelectionReport instead of just a slice of matches.
Switched from SelectRelevant() to PreviewSelection() to obtain the full SelectionReport for the prompt tester.
View updated to render INJECT/SKIP labels with skip reasons; raw score numbers removed.
Setting activeTab in test structs was an unusedwrite lint error because tests called injectionTab.view() directly; those assignments were removed.

workflow: The 'RECENT INJECTIONS' section contained 'Injection Detail' which has 'INJECT' as a substring, causing a false positive in the empty-state test assertion — substring checks need care when section headers share tokens with content labels.
unusedwrite lint fires when a struct field is assigned in a test but the test calls a method directly on the sub-model rather than going through the root model.

friction: Plan mode was interrupted twice by the user before implementation could begin, requiring re-entry.
Empty-state test assertion incorrectly matched because 'RECENT INJECTIONS' header contained 'INJECT' as a substring of 'Injection Detail'.
lint flagged activeTab field writes in tests as unusedwrite because tests bypassed the root model and called tab view directly.
open_items: Removal of skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands and all related code — this task was planned but not yet executed at transcript end.
